# Distribution-shift levels (generated by `scripts/describe_presets.py`; do not edit by hand)

Training uses `id` only. The shifted presets change the TRUE simulator parameters; the rover never observes them.

| Parameter | id | terrain_shift | sensor_shift | dynamics_shift | combined_shift |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Terrain: P(normal / sand / rock) | 0.60 / 0.15 / 0.10 | 0.35 / 0.25 / 0.22 | 0.60 / 0.15 / 0.10 | 0.60 / 0.15 / 0.10 | 0.35 / 0.25 / 0.22 |
| Terrain patch correlation (gen_corr) | 2 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Obstacle probability (1 − Σ) | 0.15 | 0.18 | 0.15 | 0.15 | 0.18 |
| Energy per cell (normal / sand / rock) | 1 / 3 / 5 | 1 / 3 / 5 | 1 / 3 / 5 | 1 / 4 / 6 | 1 / 4 / 6 |
| Slip probability (normal / sand / rock) | 0.02 / 0.10 / 0.05 | 0.02 / 0.10 / 0.05 | 0.02 / 0.10 / 0.05 | 0.06 / 0.25 / 0.15 | 0.06 / 0.25 / 0.15 |
| Sensor miss rate | 0.05 | 0.05 | 0.20 | 0.05 | 0.20 |
| Sensor false-detection rate | 0.02 | 0.02 | 0.08 | 0.02 | 0.08 |
| Sensor reading noise σ | 0.05 | 0.05 | 0.15 | 0.05 | 0.15 |
| Battery capacity (energy units) | 250 | 250 | 250 | 250 | 250 |
| Grid size | 32×32 | 32×32 | 32×32 | 32×32 | 32×32 |

## What each preset shifts

* **terrain_shift** — rougher world: fewer normal cells, more sand and rock, larger patches, more obstacles (0.15 → 0.18 of cells).
* **sensor_shift** — same world, noisier sensing: 4× miss rate, 4× false-detection rate, 3× reading noise.
* **dynamics_shift** — same world and sensing, but costlier sand/rock (4/6 instead of 3/5) and 2.5–3× slip probability.
* **combined_shift** — all three together (the hardest condition).

Within a condition every method is evaluated on the identical list of map seeds (verified by the `run_experiment.py` pairing check). Across conditions the same seed gives a different terrain whenever the terrain parameters differ; conditions are compared on matched seed ranges, not on identical terrain.
